name: Olson Park Campground
evidence: City of Worthington campground map (worthingtonmn.gov public-works/olson-park/campground-map.pdf): sites 1-12 are spurs off the east road ending at the bike trail on Sunset Bay's shore, and the city prices 'sites 1-12 along the bay' above the rest; Esri z18 at 43.6084,-95.6347: RVs on sites 7-12 sit beside the paved shore path with ~10 m of open grass to the water of Sunset Bay's narrow NW arm (sites 1-6 are under canopy with shore trees); a lone path is not a buffer (as 8303, 13623). The earlier reading measured from the west-side pin.

name: Brady Lake City Campground
evidence: Campspot per-site map (bradytx): the 15 '30/50 WATER FRONT SITE's are the row on the lake side of the north loop's west road (5 more are sold as 'ELECTRIC ONLY WATERVIEW'); Esri z18 at 31.1350,-99.3836: that pull-along gravel row sits ~40-45 m from the shore across open, unused ground with scattered tree clumps, with no continuous treeline, road or day-use between. At the edge of the ~50 m bound. The earlier reading at 31.1285,-99.3833 looked only at the southern area.

name: Town of Eastend Campground
evidence: Town site map (townofeastend.com/uploads/dm/50872, sizes in /50873): sites 17-43 are spurs off the north and NE road pointing at the Frenchman River, ~10-14 m wide here; Esri Oct 2024 plus Wayback Aug 2023 and May 2019 at 49.5184,-108.8270: the north row's site posts are ~9 m from the water, but a continuous 6-8 m willow thicket (stemmy in the leaf-off May capture) lines the bank, so creekside is not earned; the NE row (27-43) is 20-40 m back behind riparian scrub. The river runs just past that thicket: riverview.

name: Applegate River Golf & RV Resort
evidence: Campspot per-site map (applegatervresort): the 12 'Waterfront 30/50 RV Site's are the east lane of pull-throughs; Esri z18 at 42.3405,-123.3534: those pads are ~20-26 m from an Applegate River backwater slough (~25-50 m wide) that joins the main channel at the lot's south end (z15), where the river is ~26-35 m from the southern pads. Between pads and water run the lot's paved east perimeter drive and an 11-13 m mowed strip: an open view, but a road between (as 2820, 1440, 680). The golf holes are across the water, not between.

name: Amazing Rocky Park Campground
evidence: Operator resort map (daivarv.ca Amazing-Rocky-Park-Map PDF, dated 2026-01-12): a creek leaves the Rocky Saugeen below the hydro dam and runs through the lower loop, with transient 15-amp RV sites 17, 19 and 20 on its south bank and 47 and 48 on its north (Campspot 'Partial Service - 15 AMP + Water', 35 ft max); Esri z18 (Oct 2020) at 44.2321,-80.8277 is canopy-blind, but the OSM/CanVec stream (ways 69279767, 69277332) runs between those rows. The river itself (17-26 m wide below the dam) is 30-55 m from the nearest pads behind a tree band; only tent sites 1-5 are on its bank.

name: Bear Lake Experience
evidence: Campspot per-site map (bear-lake-experience-warwick): the five '30 Amp Shady Lakeside' sites (01, 05, 06, 07, 09) each carry Campspot's 'Waterfront Site' flag, and the type reads 'along the bank of our 2 acre spring fed pond'; four form the row between the pond's SE shore and the campground road, ~18-25 m from the water (map scaled to the pond, 126 m across on Esri), with nothing drawn between, and the type's photo shows a trailer under shade trees with the pond across open mowed lawn. Esri z18 (Sept 2022, the newest capture) at 43.0064,-81.9342 predates the row, so it can't veto. Pin moved off the pond onto that row.

name: Hyclass Ocean Campground
evidence: Campspot per-site map and the operator's 2021 site map (Wayback, hyclass-campground.com/portals/16/Hyclass-map.pdf): the shoreside column on the cove (H0-H4) is walk-in tents; the 'Ocean Front' primitive Tent/RV sites E1-E3 (24 ft) sit inside the point's loop road, with the road and the open point (fire pit, volleyball, dock) between them and the water, and the type's photos show the harbour beyond a gravel road and a shrub band; the 'Ocean View' pull-throughs B10-B17 fill an oval loop ~35-40 m above the cove behind the loop road and a shore treeline. Esri z18 at 45.6455,-61.5823: the loop road runs along both the cobble harbour shore and the cove; north of the entry road is a hay field.

name: Spirit Springs Campground
evidence: Campspot per-site map (spiritspringscampground): the three 'FULL HOOK-UP WATERFRONT' sites (01, 02, 13) carry no 'Waterfront Site' flag and sit across the entry road (01, 02) or the branch road (13, by the covered footbridge) from the drawn lake; the type's nine photos show sites under trees and the covered bridge, never the water. Esri z18 (Nov 2020, the newest capture; Wayback back to 2011) at 41.9814,-85.8031: a 30-60 m deciduous belt lines the marsh lake's west bank between the campground's open field and the water. Not confirmable.

name: Rivers Bend Family Resort
evidence: Campspot per-site map (riversbendfamilyresort): the bookable RV sites (pull-throughs 11-12 in the central loop, back-ins 14-16 at the back) sit on open ground with roads and other sites between them and the spring branch, and Shoal Creek is 100+ m north; the creek-side sites are tent sites on Tent Island, and the two 'Spring Side' RV types offered no site on any of six dates read (Oct 2026 to Jun 2027). Esri z17 at 37.0119,-94.5086: the RV loops are on open ground south of the creek's tree belt. The operator's 'park your RV on the edge of Shoal Creek' is marketing.
